description: Find images for sale by description, mood, colour or subject — a plain description of the feeling or scene works as well as a keyword, so pass what the person actually said. Give target_width and target_height when the image is destined for a specific screen — results are then ranked by how close each frame is to that shape, and frames whose shape is badly wrong for it (a landscape frame for a phone) are left out. Images are sold as the photographer framed them, never cropped. Returns a preview of each image. Use get_image for one listing you already have the id of; use list_collections to browse rather than search.

collection_id.description: Restrict to one collection from list_collections.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged, with the same query and filters. Cannot be combined with target_width/target_height.

include_previews.description: Set false for metadata only, which is much cheaper.

licence.description: "commercial" for only the images that can be licensed for business use. Every image has the personal license.

query.description: Free text: subject, mood, colour, setting.

target_height.description: Destination height in pixels, e.g. 2796. Give both or neither.

target_width.description: Destination width in pixels, e.g. 1290 for an iPhone. Give both or neither.

name: search_images
title: Search the image catalogue
